section.title: WARNING: FETAL TOXICITY
section.text: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue ZESTRIL as soon as possible. Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus.

section.title: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE
section.text: ZESTRIL is an angiotensin converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor indicated for treatment of hypertension in adult patients and pediatric patients 6 years of age and older, and adjunctive therapy in heart failure.

section.title: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION
section.text: Hypertension: Initial adult dose is 10 mg once daily. Titrate up to 40 mg daily based on blood pressure goals. Heart Failure: Initial dose is 5 mg once daily with diuretics.

section.title: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS
section.text: History of angioedema related to previous ACE inhibitor treatment, hereditary or idiopathic angioedema, and concomitant use with aliskiren in patients with diabetes.

section.title: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS
section.text: Angioedema and Anaphylactoid Reactions: Discontinue ZESTRIL immediately. Impaired Renal Function: Monitor serum creatinine. Hyperkalemia: Monitor serum potassium periodically.
